error[ZBX-E0506]: the registry is rate limiting this host
  cause  https://registry.test/v2/fixture/limited/manifests/3.20 answered 429:
         the pull rate limit is used up; wait 30
  fix    wait a few minutes, then run the command again
         or ask a mirror of Docker Hub first, for example:   ZBX_REGISTRY_MIRRORS=mirror.gcr.io zbx pull alpine:3.20
  more   zbx explain E0506 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0506.html
